title: Pure Dark Blade
summary: Pure Dark Blade beatdown and Fusion strategy centered on the iconic Level 4 DARK Warrior Normal Monster and its Union dragon companions, Pitch-Dark Dragon and Kiryu. Supported by Unexpected Dai, Rescue Rabbit, and Fusion Deployment, the deck equips its dragons to pierce and protect Dark Blade or fuses into Dark Blade the Dragon Knight to banish opposing GY resources.

summary.title: Starters
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons the original Dark Blade directly from your Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Rescue Rabbit banishes itself from the field to Special Summon two copies of Dark Blade from your Deck simultaneously.
Fusion Deployment reveals Dark Blade the Dragon Knight in your Extra Deck to Special Summon Dark Blade or Pitch-Dark Dragon directly from your Deck.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Dark Blade or its retrain, Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World, from Deck to hand.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai + Pitch-Dark Dragon
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai with an empty field to Special Summon Dark Blade from your Deck.
Normal Summon Pitch-Dark Dragon and activate its effect to equip itself to Dark Blade.
Dark Blade gains 400 ATK/DEF (reaching 2200 ATK), inflicts piercing battle damage, and Pitch-Dark Dragon destroys itself to shield Dark Blade from battle destruction.
Alternatively, activate Polymerization to fuse Dark Blade and Pitch-Dark Dragon into Dark Blade the Dragon Knight.
Set Roll Out! to equip Kiryu or Pitch-Dark Dragon back from your GY during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dark Blade the Dragon Knight banishes up to 3 Monster Cards from the opponent's GY every time it inflicts battle damage, completely devastating GY-reliant strategies.
First of the Dragons is a Level 9 Dragon Fusion summoned with two Dark Blades that cannot be destroyed by battle (except by Normal Monsters) and is completely unaffected by monster effects.
Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World banishes a DARK monster from your GY to equip an opponent's Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster, and tributes an equipped monster to destroy any card on the field.
Ferocious Flame Swordsman boosts all Warrior monsters by 500 ATK and revives a non-Link Warrior from the GY upon destruction.
S:P Little Knight banishes a card on field or GY on summon and temporarily banishes two face-up monsters as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Roll Out! is a Normal Trap that targets and equips a Union monster (Pitch-Dark Dragon or Kiryu) from your GY directly to an appropriate monster you control.
Polymerization fuses Dark Blade with Pitch-Dark Dragon for Dragon Knight, or two Dark Blades for First of the Dragons.
Kiryu equips to Dark Blade to grant a 900 ATK boost (raising it to 2700 ATK) and substitutes for Dark Blade's destruction.

main: Dark Blade
Signature Level 4 DARK Warrior Normal Monster with 1800 ATK that serves as the host for Pitch-Dark Dragon and Kiryu and Fusion Material for Dragon Knight.
Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World
Effect retrain of Dark Blade that banishes 1 DARK monster from GY to equip a Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster from opponent's field, and tributes an Equip to destroy a card.
Pitch-Dark Dragon
DARK Dragon Union monster that equips to Dark Blade to boost its ATK/DEF by 400 and grant piercing battle damage.
Kiryu
DARK Dragon Union monster that tributes a DARK monster to summon itself and equips to Dark Blade to boost its ATK/DEF by 900 (to 2700 ATK).
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to summon 2 Dark Blade from the Deck for Fusion, Xyz, or Link plays.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Dark Blade from the Deck without using your Normal Summon.
Fusion Deployment
Reveals Dark Blade the Dragon Knight to summon Dark Blade or Pitch-Dark Dragon directly from the Deck.
Polymerization
Fuses Dark Blade and Pitch-Dark Dragon (or two Normal Dark Blades into First of the Dragons).
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Dark Blade or Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World.
Roll Out!
Equips Pitch-Dark Dragon or Kiryu from your GY to Dark Blade during either player's turn.
